purpose: Authentic static parked/stowed Rocket illustration on the central tablet; no rear-camera feed and no per-frame model render.
sourceAnchorMeaning: Immutable accepted model baseline; retained only while the geometry fingerprint matches. Current render inputs are recorded separately.
geometryFingerprintMethod: SHA256 canonical sorted-key GLB JSON; buffer byte lengths and view offsets/lengths removed; each view replaced by its SHA256 except the one named tablet image. Includes all nodes, extras, materials, accessors, geometry and other images; only the exact new Roadster.driverDisplay.ui_artwork description is canonicalized to its original value.

composition.colorSpace: Explicit sRGB decode, linear-light alpha-over, explicit sRGB encode; Blender byte-buffer PNG stores encoded values unchanged
composition.clearRegionReason: The obsolete 3px roof-outline brush extended to y245, two rows above the prior silhouette bounds; all live readout regions remain outside.
composition.background: Unmodified procedural dark UI gradient, identical to same-row x=10

render.reduction: 3x3 area average in premultiplied linear RGB/alpha, then unpremultiply
render.pose: Existing authored aeroStowPositionOffset and aeroStowAxis/aeroStowAngle applied at deployment=0 only during render
render.recursionPrevention: Hide RC_Original_Infotainment_Display only in temporary render scene; reopen unmodified .blend before packing UI
render.modelMaterials: All source model materials unchanged during render and in outputs

verification.uiArtworkDescription: Offline Blender render of this authored Rocket in parked/stowed pose; live game instruments remain separate; no factory UI claim.
